description: This file contains RISC-V architecture-specific SMP (Symmetric Multiprocessing) initialization and management code for Zephyr OS, including CPU startup, inter-processor interrupts, and FPU sharing.

methods.name: arch_start_cpu
methods.description: Starts a CPU with specified stack, function, and argument.

methods.name: arch_secondary_cpu_init
methods.description: Initializes a secondary CPU based on its hartid.

methods.name: arch_sched_ipi
methods.description: Sends inter-processor interrupts to other CPUs for scheduling.

methods.name: arch_flush_fpu_ipi
methods.description: Sends an FPU flush request to a specific CPU.

methods.name: arch_spin_relax
methods.description: Prevents deadlock by handling pending FPU flush requests during spinlock contention.

methods.name: arch_smp_init
methods.description: Initializes SMP support, including setting up IPI handler.
